_about: Copy this file to ~/.config/claude-buddy/census.json (chmod 600) and keep only what you need.
Without that file the census lists the headless Claude runs (claude -p) and nothing else.
Keys that start with _ and keys it does not know are ignored.
jobs: each match is compared with the NAME of a process's script or program (never with its arguments).
regex: true makes match a regular expression (re.search); name may use {script}, {cwd} and {prog}.
strip_prefix is cut from folder names (runs and {cwd}), so work-alpha shows as alpha.
url: http only, and only this Mac or the tailnet; insecure_url_ok lifts that. CLAUDE_BUDDY_URL wins over url.
